features.name: marks_margin
features.description: Student marks percentage minus scholarship minimum required marks (can be negative if below requirement)

features.name: income_headroom_ratio
features.description: Normalized headroom below scholarship income ceiling: (ceiling - income) / ceiling; 1.0 if scheme has no income limit

features.name: course_match
features.description: 1 if student course is eligible or scholarship is open to all courses, 0 otherwise

features.name: qualification_match
features.description: 1 if student education level matches scheme qualification levels, 0 otherwise

features.name: state_match
features.description: 1 if student domicile state matches eligible states or scheme is All-India, 0 otherwise

features.name: category_match
features.description: 1 if student caste/social category matches scheme or scheme is All/General, 0 otherwise

features.name: gender_match
features.description: 1 if student gender matches scheme or scheme is open to all genders, 0 otherwise

features.name: disability_match
features.description: 1 if scheme does not require disability OR student meets benchmark disability percentage, 0 otherwise

features.name: is_first_generation
features.description: 1 if student is a first-generation college learner, 0 otherwise

features.name: hard_criteria_passed
features.description: 1 if all mandatory rule-based constraints (course, state, category, min marks, max income) are satisfied, 0 if any failed

target.name: target_match
target.description: 1 indicates a verified eligible candidate with strong competitive and socio-economic priority; 0 indicates either failing hard eligibility or lower competitive alignment.

dataset_metadata.split_strategy: GroupShuffleSplit (grouped by student_id to prevent data leakage)
dataset_metadata.disclaimer: This dataset contains simulated student-scholarship interactions for academic and algorithmic validation. It does not contain private or real-world applicant records.
